At the end there's a cheat sheet you can screenshot.

videos.title: Stop Printing at 100% Infill! #shorts
videos.description:
More infill means more plastic and more time, but often barely more strength. Walls carry most of the load. My recipe for functional parts: 3–4 walls and 15–20% gyroid, and print in the right orientation.

videos.title: This Free Setting Removes Layer Lines From 3D Prints
videos.description:
Z anti-aliasing lets the nozzle move up and down inside a single layer, so curved top surfaces lose their staircase look. In CNC Kitchen's test, roughness on shallow slopes dropped from about 80 to about 25 micrometers. In OrcaSlicer it's called Z contouring.
